outcome: Infectious diseases in infants up to 1 year of age (lower respiratory tract inflammation, congenital anomalies)
cohort: 103,060 pregnant women from the Japan Environment and Children's Study
finding: AYA cancer survivors, particularly those with cervical cancer, had increased risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes, and infants born to cervical cancer survivors via vaginal delivery had a higher risk of lower respiratory tract inflammation at 1 year of age.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were increased in all cancer survivors.
